text: The committee meeting date is held as a durable timer inside CaseWorkflow: the routing step signals the meeting date, CaseWorkflow waits on it and raises TimerBreached through its own state, the timer row of rwb_case is only the projection behind the timers read, and this story registers no Temporal Schedule, no Quartz row and no timer-check job
why: No source says whether booking a committee meeting is a Schedule or a durable timer: Architecture v5 slide 44 names JOB-16 (monthly write-off scan) as the only write-off Schedule, the durable-timer pattern of Temporal and Drools Design v1 slide 14 is described for the stage clocks, and a booking is one date for one case and not a cadence

impact: One durable timer and one projection row; if a meeting cadence is later needed it becomes a Schedule in rwb-writeoff and does not change this story
